integrity: Self-contained proofs with reproducible exhaustive finite checks; computations are corroboration, not infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Uniform labeled invertible structure matrices over F_2 only. The bound applies n>=32, and asymptotics are n->infinity. No results on general q, sparse ensembles, or class-uniform sampling. Historical-priority risk for hidden matrix orbit enumeration remains.
title: Sharp binary symmetry asymptotics for random perfect evolution algebras
